output.text: The regional debate tournament drew a large crowd, and the volunteer coffee shop next door stayed busy the whole weekend. Assume that Kai is the head judge. Cy arrived earliest among the volunteers, well before the first round began, and Uma got there about twenty minutes later. Fay showed up closer to midday, once the preliminary rounds were underway, and Noor arrived somewhere between the two extremes. Cy and Uma worked different shifts. Kai stood taller than both Cy and Noor, though Uma was the tallest of the group overall. The tournament brackets were posted near the registration table, and teams checked their room assignments throughout the morning. Uma and Fay worked different shifts. Noor took the photographs. Fay was younger than Cy but older than Uma, and Kai was the oldest of everyone present that day. Several teams ranked highly from previous tournaments competed in the afternoon divisions, which made the later rounds especially tense. Cy and Fay worked different shifts. The volunteers kept the shop stocked with pastries and coffee for the exhausted debaters between rounds. Noor ranked the shop tasks by priority each morning, deciding which orders to fill first. The shop ran three shifts. By evening, the last matches wrapped up, and the volunteers began cleaning the tables and folding the extra chairs. Cy left before Fay did, though Uma stayed later than either of them to help lock up. Everyone agreed the tournament had gone smoothly, and the shop had managed to keep pace with the steady stream of customers all day long.
